description: Estimate WhatsApp outgoing call costs from monthly minutes, using the same reference rate as Waply's web calculator. Incoming calls are free. The calling rate is a reference heuristic, NOT a verified official Meta calling tariff; always present the total as a reference estimate requiring rate-card confirmation. Excludes Waply plans, AI/provider fees and taxes.

market.description: Exact market id from list_meta_pricing_markets, based on the recipient's country calling code. Do not infer it from the user's language.

outgoingMinutes.description: Total outgoing minutes per month, as entered in the web calculator. Exclude incoming calls.

name: calculate_call_cost
